headlines.title: New cervical cancer guidance to favor HPV screening over traditional Pap tests
headlines.description: New cervical cancer guidance to recommend for the first time that women ages 30 to 65 be screened for HPV rather than with the traditional Pap test.

headlines.title: Injected cadaver skin: the latest anti-aging product in the Korean skincare frenzy
headlines.description: South Korean skincare is all the rage these days with tourists flying thousands of miles for their next fix. Re20 is a new treatment made with donated cadaver skin that’s injected into your face. It’s not FDA approved which is raising some concerns about ethics and safety. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Olivia Munn and Sen. Mark Kelly fight to make breast cancer risk assessment test routine
headlines.description: Olivia Munn has been documenting her battle with breast cancer for years. Now she's on Capitol Hill with Senator Mark Kelly working to make a simple online risk assessment test a routine part of health care for women. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Thanksgiving Desserts That Come Together in Minutes
headlines.description: From mini cheesecakes packed with big flavor to cranberry pecan granola cookies, TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer shares easy and healthy make-ahead Thanksgiving dessert ideas.

headlines.title: Iowa residents protest Army’s planned detonation of bomb-making chemicals
headlines.description: Iowa residents are raising concerns about the planned detonation of lead azide in Middleton, Iowa, scheduled for Friday. KWQC’s Chandler Brindley reports as residents worry that a cloud of lead dust could cause environmental contamination and health risks.
